objective_pt: Abrir uma reunião, pedir a palavra, interromper com educação e fechar com os próximos passos.

teacher.goal_pt: Ativar o vocabulário de reuniões que o aluno já usa no trabalho e ver como ele abre uma conversa formal.
prompts: How many meetings do you usually have a week?
What makes a meeting a waste of time?
watchFor: Dizer "assist a meeting" (falso cognato de "assistir"); o certo é "attend a meeting".
Dizer "make a meeting" em vez de "have" ou "hold a meeting".

exercises.prompt: Shall we get started? Everyone seems to be here.
accepted: Shall we get started? Everyone seems to be here.
Shall we get started? Everyone seems to be here now.

exercises.instruction_pt: Which sentence means "participar de uma reunião"?
exercises.explanation_pt: "Attend" é participar, comparecer. "Assist" é um falso cognato: significa ajudar.

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Eu tenho uma reunião às três."
accepted: I have a meeting at three
I've got a meeting at three
I have a meeting at 3
I have a meeting at three o'clock
I've got a meeting at three o'clock
I have a meeting at 3 pm

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em inglês a gente "has" ou "holds" uma reunião, não "makes". "Fazer uma reunião" vira "have a meeting".
commonErrors.correction_en: I have a meeting at three.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para horário usamos "at": "at three". "In three" soaria como "daqui a três (minutos/dias)".
commonErrors.correction_en: I have a meeting at three.

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender expressões para conduzir uma reunião: agenda, action items, follow up, postpone, wrap up.
prompts: What's usually on the agenda of your team meetings?
Who follows up after a meeting at your company?
watchFor: Pronunciar "agenda" com a tônica no começo (A-gen-da); o certo é a-GEN-da.

exercises.example_en: There are three items on the agenda today.
I'll follow up with an email after the call.
Let's wrap up, we're running out of time.

exercises.instruction_pt: Match each expression to its meaning.
Say it in English: "Vamos adiar a reunião para sexta."
accepted: Let's postpone the meeting to Friday
Let's postpone the meeting until Friday
Let's postpone the meeting till Friday
Let's push the meeting to Friday
Let's push the meeting back to Friday
Let's move the meeting to Friday
Let's reschedule the meeting for Friday
Let's put the meeting off until Friday
Let's put off the meeting until Friday
Let us postpone the meeting to Friday

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Prorrogar" em inglês é "extend" (fazer durar mais). Para mudar para depois, use "postpone" ou "push back".
commonErrors.correction_en: Let's postpone the meeting to Friday.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com "postpone" o natural é "to" ou "until Friday". "For" combina com "reschedule".
commonErrors.correction_en: Let's postpone the meeting to Friday.

teacher.goal_pt: Treinar a tônica de palavras de reunião (a-GEN-da, SCHED-ule) e a entonação educada de interrupção.
prompts: Say "agenda" and "schedule". Where is the stress?
How do you interrupt politely in Portuguese? And in English?
watchFor: Entonação plana em "Sorry to interrupt", que soa ríspida; a voz deve subir um pouco.

exercises.instruction_pt: Repeat. Stress the second syllable: a-GEN-da.
accepted: Let's stick to the agenda.
Let us stick to the agenda.

exercises.instruction_pt: Repeat with a friendly, rising tone.
exercises.prompt: Sorry to interrupt, but could I just add something?
accepted: Sorry to interrupt, but could I just add something?
Sorry to interrupt, but can I just add something?
Sorry to interrupt, could I just add something?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "sorry" use "to interrupt" ou "for interrupting" (com -ing).
commonErrors.correction_en: Sorry to interrupt, but could I just add something?

exercises.explanation_pt: A tônica é na primeira sílaba: SCHED-ule. No inglês americano soa "SKÉ-djul"; no britânico, "CHÉ-djul".

teacher.goal_pt: Entender frases típicas de quem conduz a reunião e reagir a elas.
prompts: What does "let's park that for now" mean?
What do you say if you missed what someone said in a call?

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen and choose what the speaker wants.
exercises.listen: That's a good point, but let's park it for now and come back to it at the end.
options: To discuss the point right now
exercises.explanation_pt: "Park it for now" é deixar o assunto de lado por enquanto para voltar a ele depois ("come back to it at the end").

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen and say that you agree with the proposal.
exercises.listen: So, does everyone agree with the new deadline?
accepted: Yes, I agree
I agree
I agree with it
I agree with the new deadline
Yes, I agree with the new deadline
Yes, I'm fine with it
I'm fine with it
Yes, that works for me
That works for me
Sounds good to me
Yes, sounds good
Yes, it's fine by me
Fine by me
I'm on board
Yes, I'm on board with that
Absolutely
Yes, absolutely

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Agree" já é verbo: "I agree". "I am agree" é tradução literal de "estou de acordo".
commonErrors.correction_en: Yes, I agree.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Concordamos "with" alguma coisa: "I agree with the new deadline".
commonErrors.correction_en: I agree with the new deadline.

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen. The connection was bad. Ask the person to repeat.
exercises.listen: Sorry, you broke up a bit there. Could you repeat that?
accepted: Sorry, could you repeat that?
Could you repeat that?
Could you say that again?
Sorry, could you say that again?
Sorry, can you repeat that?
Can you say that again?
Sorry, I didn't catch that
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you repeat it?
Sorry, I missed that. Could you repeat it?
Could you repeat that, please?
Sorry, could you repeat the last part?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Repeat" já significa "dizer de novo", então "repeat again" é redundante. Use "repeat that" ou "say that again".
commonErrors.correction_en: Sorry, could you repeat that?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "didn't" o verbo fica na forma base: "I didn't understand" ou "I didn't catch that".
commonErrors.correction_en: Sorry, I didn't catch that.

teacher.goal_pt: Conduzir uma mini-reunião: abrir, passar para o próximo item e fechar com os próximos passos.
prompts: Can you open our meeting for me?
How would you move on to the next item?
Who's doing what after this meeting?
watchFor: Dizer "pass to the next topic" (tradução de "passar para o próximo"); o natural é "move on to".

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Vamos passar para o próximo item da pauta."
accepted: Let's move on to the next item on the agenda
Let's move on to the next item
Let's go on to the next item on the agenda
Let's move to the next item on the agenda
Let's move on to the next point on the agenda
Moving on to the next item on the agenda
Let us move on to the next item on the agenda
Shall we move on to the next item on the agenda?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Passar para o próximo" em reunião é "move on to the next item". "Pass" soa como passar a vez ou entregar algo.
commonErrors.correction_en: Let's move on to the next item on the agenda.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Itens ficam "on the agenda", com "on".
commonErrors.correction_en: Let's move on to the next item on the agenda.

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Precisamos discutir o orçamento antes de decidir."
accepted: We need to discuss the budget before deciding
We need to discuss the budget before we decide
We have to discuss the budget before deciding
We have to discuss the budget before we decide
We need to talk about the budget before deciding
We need to talk about the budget before we decide
We need to go over the budget before we decide
We should discuss the budget before we decide

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Discuss" não leva "about": "discuss the budget". Se quiser "about", use "talk about".
commonErrors.correction_en: We need to discuss the budget before we decide.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "before" use o verbo com -ing ("before deciding") ou uma frase completa ("before we decide").
commonErrors.correction_en: We need to discuss the budget before deciding.

exercises.instruction_pt: Role-play. You are chairing a short meeting.
exercises.scene_pt: You are leading a 15-minute call with two colleagues. Open the meeting, keep it on track and close it.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Hi, sorry I'm a bit late. Have you already started?

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que não tem problema e que estão só começando.
accepted: No problem, we're just getting started
Don't worry, we're just getting started
No worries, we're just starting
No problem, we're just starting
Don't worry, we've just started
No problem, we've just started

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Sem problema" é "no problem". "No have" não existe.
commonErrors.correction_en: No problem, we're just getting started.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Just" vem antes do verbo principal: "we're just starting".
commonErrors.correction_en: No problem, we're just getting started.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Great. So, what's on the agenda today?

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que há dois itens: o orçamento e o cronograma.
accepted: There are two items: the budget and the schedule
We have two items: the budget and the schedule
There are two items on the agenda: the budget and the schedule
We've got two items: the budget and the schedule
Two items: the budget and the schedule
There are two things: the budget and the schedule
We have two items, the budget and the timeline
There are two items, the budget and the timeline

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para "há/existem" use "there are", não "it has".
commonErrors.correction_en: There are two items: the budget and the schedule.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Cronograma" é "schedule" ou "timeline".
commonErrors.correction_en: There are two items: the budget and the schedule.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Actually, I'd like to talk about the new office too. It's a big issue for my team.

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que é importante, mas sugira deixar para o fim.
accepted: That's important, but let's leave it for the end
That's important, but can we leave it for the end?
That's important, but let's park it for now
That's important, but let's come back to it at the end
Good point, but let's leave it for the end
Good point, but let's park it for now
It's important, but let's leave it until the end
That's important, but could we discuss it at the end?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "No final" (da reunião) é "at the end" ou "for the end". "The final" é a final de um campeonato.
commonErrors.correction_en: That's important, but let's leave it for the end.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "let's" o verbo vem sem "to".
commonErrors.correction_en: Let's leave it for the end.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Fair enough. We're nearly out of time, actually.

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Encerre: diga que vão encerrar e que você manda a ata depois.
accepted: Okay, let's wrap up. I'll send the minutes later
Okay, let's wrap up. I'll send the minutes afterwards
Let's wrap up then. I'll send the minutes later
Okay, let's wrap it up. I'll send the minutes after the call
Let's wrap up. I'll send out the minutes later
Okay, let's finish here. I'll send the minutes later

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Ata" é "minutes".
commonErrors.correction_en: Okay, let's wrap up. I'll send the minutes later.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A expressão é "wrap up" (encerrar).
commonErrors.correction_en: Let's wrap up.

exercises.instruction_pt: You are chairing a short team meeting. Open it, introduce the agenda and close with next steps.
exercises.prompt_en: Okay, everyone's here. Could you open the meeting and tell us what we're going to cover today?
guidelines_pt: Open the meeting: "Thanks for joining. Shall we get started?"
Present two or three items: "First, we'll look at... Then..."
Close with next steps: "So, to wrap up, Ana will follow up on..."

teacher.goal_pt: Revisar as expressões de reunião e o falso cognato "attend/assist".
prompts: How do you politely interrupt someone?
What do you say at the end of a meeting?
watchFor: Esquecer o "up" em "follow up" e "wrap up".

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Eu não pude participar da reunião de ontem."
accepted: I couldn't attend yesterday's meeting
I couldn't attend the meeting yesterday
I wasn't able to attend yesterday's meeting
I wasn't able to attend the meeting yesterday
I couldn't make it to yesterday's meeting
I couldn't make yesterday's meeting
I couldn't go to yesterday's meeting
I couldn't join yesterday's meeting
I couldn't be at yesterday's meeting

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Assist" significa ajudar. Para participar ou comparecer, use "attend" (sem "to").
commonErrors.correction_en: I couldn't attend yesterday's meeting.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Attend" não leva "to" no sentido de comparecer: "attend the meeting". "Attend to" significa cuidar de algo.
commonErrors.correction_en: I couldn't attend yesterday's meeting.

exercises.sentence: I'll follow ___ with an email this afternoon.
accepted: up

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A expressão é "follow up" (dar seguimento): "I'll follow up with an email".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'll follow up with an email this afternoon.

exercises.instruction_pt: Which is the most natural way to end a meeting?
options: Okay, I think that's everything. Thanks, everyone.
Okay, the meeting is finished now. Go.
exercises.explanation_pt: "I think that's everything. Thanks, everyone." é educado e natural. "Terminate" soa robótico, e "Go" soa rude.

exercises.instruction_pt: To finish, repeat the closing line.
exercises.prompt: Thanks, everyone. I'll send the minutes later today.
accepted: Thanks, everyone. I'll send the minutes later today.
Thank you, everyone. I'll send the minutes later today.
Thanks, everyone. I will send the minutes later today.

practice.instruction_pt: Repeat out loud.
practice.prompt: Thanks for joining, everyone. Let's get started.
accepted: Thanks for joining, everyone. Let's get started.

practice.instruction_pt: Repeat out loud.
practice.prompt: Can we go back to the first item on the agenda?
accepted: Can we go back to the first item on the agenda?
Could we go back to the first item on the agenda?

practice.instruction_pt: Repeat. Say "afraid" softly, it is polite.
practice.prompt: I'm afraid we're running out of time.
accepted: I'm afraid we're running out of time.

practice.instruction_pt: Repeat out loud.
practice.prompt: Could you take the minutes today?
accepted: Could you take the minutes today?
Can you take the minutes today?

practice.instruction_pt: Repeat out loud.
practice.prompt: Let's park that and come back to it later.
accepted: Let's park that and come back to it later.

practice.instruction_pt: Repeat. Stress the names and the action.
practice.prompt: Just to recap, Maria will follow up with the client.
accepted: Just to recap, Maria will follow up with the client.
Just to recap, Maria is going to follow up with the client.

practice.example_en: Sorry, the last meeting ran over by twenty minutes.

practice.word_en: to be on the same page
practice.example_en: Before we decide, let's make sure we're all on the same page.
Let's quickly go over the action items before we finish.

practice.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Você pode compartilhar sua tela?"
accepted: Can you share your screen?
Could you share your screen?
Would you share your screen?
Would you mind sharing your screen?
Can you share your screen, please?
Could you share your screen, please?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Compartilhar a tela" é "share your screen". "Divide" é dividir em partes.
commonErrors.correction_en: Can you share your screen?

practice.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Eu não participei da reunião de ontem."
accepted: I didn't attend yesterday's meeting
I didn't attend the meeting yesterday
I wasn't at yesterday's meeting
I wasn't at the meeting yesterday
I didn't go to yesterday's meeting
I didn't go to the meeting yesterday
I didn't join yesterday's meeting
I missed yesterday's meeting
I missed the meeting yesterday

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Assist" é ajudar (falso cognato). "Participar" é "attend" ou "join".
commonErrors.correction_en: I didn't attend yesterday's meeting.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Participate of" não existe. Para reuniões, o mais natural é "attend" ou "be at".
commonErrors.correction_en: I wasn't at yesterday's meeting.

practice.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Vamos discutir o orçamento na próxima reunião."
accepted: Let's discuss the budget at the next meeting
Let's discuss the budget in the next meeting
We'll discuss the budget at the next meeting
We'll discuss the budget in the next meeting
Let's talk about the budget at the next meeting
Let's talk about the budget in the next meeting
We can discuss the budget at the next meeting

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Discuss" não leva "about": "discuss the budget".
commonErrors.correction_en: Let's discuss the budget.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Orçamento" (dinheiro planejado) é "budget". "Quote" é o orçamento de um fornecedor.
commonErrors.correction_en: Let's discuss the budget at the next meeting.

practice.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Quem vai conduzir a reunião amanhã?"
accepted: Who's going to chair the meeting tomorrow?
Who's chairing the meeting tomorrow?
Who will chair the meeting tomorrow?
Who's going to run the meeting tomorrow?
Who's running the meeting tomorrow?
Who will run the meeting tomorrow?
Who's going to lead the meeting tomorrow?
Who's leading the meeting tomorrow?
Who will lead the meeting tomorrow?

Who's chairing tomorrow's meeting?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Conduct" existe, mas é bem formal. No dia a dia use "chair", "run" ou "lead the meeting".
commonErrors.correction_en: Who's chairing the meeting tomorrow?

practice.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Desculpe, você pode repetir a última parte?"
accepted: Sorry, could you repeat the last part?
Sorry, can you repeat the last part?
Sorry, could you say the last part again?
Sorry, can you say the last part again?
Sorry, could you repeat that last part?
Sorry, would you mind repeating the last part?
Sorry, I didn't catch the last part. Could you repeat it?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Repeat again" é redundante: "repeat" já é dizer de novo. Use "repeat" ou "say it again".
commonErrors.correction_en: Sorry, could you repeat the last part?

practice.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Acho que deveríamos adiar essa decisão."
accepted: I think we should postpone this decision
I think we should postpone that decision
I think we should put off this decision
I think we should put this decision off
I think we should delay this decision
I think we should hold off on this decision
I think we should postpone this decision for now

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Prorrogar" é "extend". Para deixar para depois, use "postpone" ou "put off".

practice.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Vou mandar a ata para todo mundo depois da reunião."
accepted: I'll send the minutes to everyone after the meeting
I'll send everyone the minutes after the meeting
I'm going to send the minutes to everyone after the meeting
I'm going to send everyone the minutes after the meeting
I'll send the minutes to everybody after the meeting
I'll send the meeting notes to everyone after the meeting

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Ata" de reunião é "minutes" (sempre no plural) ou "meeting notes".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'll send the minutes to everyone after the meeting.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Todo mundo" é "everyone" ou "everybody", não "all people".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'll send the minutes to everyone after the meeting.

practice.instruction_pt: Listen and say that you can take the minutes.

accepted: I can take the minutes
I'll take the minutes
I can do it
I'll do it

Sure, I'll do it
Yes, I'll take them
I can take them

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com a ata, o verbo é "take": "take the minutes".
commonErrors.correction_en: I can take the minutes.

practice.instruction_pt: Listen and say that you agree.
practice.listen: I suggest we move the deadline to next Friday. What do you think?
accepted: I agree
I agree with that
I agree with you
I think that works
That works for me
That sounds good
That sounds good to me
Sounds good to me

practice.instruction_pt: Listen and ask to add something before they finish.

Sorry, can I just add something?
Before we wrap up, could I add something?
Before we finish, could I add something?

Can I just add one thing?

Sorry, I didn't catch the last part
No, sorry, could you repeat it?
No, sorry, could you say it again?
Not really, could you repeat that?
No, I missed the last part
Sorry, I missed the last part
No, I didn't catch the part about the budget
Sorry, could you repeat the part about the budget?

commonErrors.correction_en: Could you repeat that?

practice.instruction_pt: Your colleague says: "Let's take this offline." What does she mean?
options: Let's discuss it later, outside this meeting

practice.instruction_pt: Which is the most polite way to interrupt?
practice.explanation_pt: "Sorry to jump in" é um jeito educado e muito comum de pedir a palavra.

practice.instruction_pt: Complete the sentence.

accepted: over
late

practice.instruction_pt: Complete the sentence.
practice.sentence: Let's go ___ the action items one more time.
accepted: over
through

practice.instruction_pt: Put the words in order to move the meeting forward.

practice.instruction_pt: Role-play. Take part in a project meeting.
practice.scene_pt: You are in a weekly team meeting. The project manager, Laura, is chairing it.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Morning, everyone. Thanks for joining. First on the agenda is the launch date. Any updates?

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que o time de design precisa de mais uma semana.

The design team needs another week
The design team needs an extra week
Yes, the design team needs one more week
Yes, the design team needs another week
The design team needs a bit more time, about one more week
The design team needs one more week to finish

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em inglês a ordem é "one more week" ou "another week". "More one week" é tradução literal.
commonErrors.correction_en: The design team needs one more week.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "The team" é terceira pessoa do singular: "needs".
commonErrors.correction_en: The design team needs one more week.

turns.speaker: partner

turns.speaker: you

I agree, but we need to let the client know
I agree, but we have to tell the client
I agree, but we have to let the client know
That's fine, but we need to tell the client
That's fine, but we need to let the client know

Fine by me, but we need to tell the client

commonErrors.correction_en: I agree, but we need to let the client know.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Good point. Could you follow up with them after this call?

turns.speaker: you

turns.speaker: partner

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Da minha parte" é "from me" ou "from my side".

practice.instruction_pt: Recap a meeting for a colleague who missed it.
practice.prompt_en: I couldn't make it to the meeting this morning. What did I miss?
guidelines_pt: Say what was discussed: "We went over..."
Say what was decided: "We agreed to..."
Give the action items: "You're supposed to follow up on..."
